description:
You may remember this character from years back, here: http://fav.me/d5lb2gk This is an updated version of the design, with my current style. You might also notice she resembles the dragon cultist, Sarah: http://fav.me/d9q3n29 but make no mistake! Wrinry came first!


Here is the story synopsis:

Wrinry is a young dragon cursed into human form. A fact that doesn't really bother her until she realizes that without wings, she can never return to the mountain top she calls home. It's up to her familiar Sivil and some unlikely friends to help her get back and discover why she was cursed in the first place.

This is a short comic series I've had in the back of my mind for a long while, but just haven't had the time to fully realize yet. I still I think it has a lot of potential, though! With some help, maybe it could make for a nice side project.

description:
A lot of people don't know this, but I was a HUGE Pokemon fan back when it first started coming to the west. To the point where an 11-year-old me once left a note to my future self, to hopefully one day remind him of the passion he once held for the show, once it had stopped running (haha).


Little did I know, new episodes and games would still be coming out two decades later. And truth be told I haven't been keeping up with the show. (sorry, younger me) I pretty much left it behind around Gen II. That being said, I am starting to become interested in seeing what I've been missing out on recently, and the new upcoming release has me intrigued. I plan to dive back in and hopefully rekindle some of those old feelings I once had for my very first fandom obsession.

So, without further ado... here's an inappropriately affectionate Lycanroc. :P

Announcing Sunday Sketch Requests!
description:
Starting November, I'll be taking weekly suggestions for sketches! Anyone pledging $10 or more are welcome to add your ideas each week. Please note, I likely will not get to them all. I'll generally be looking for funny or creative suggestions, or just whatever sounds the most fun! Requests for pin-up style sketches or a little sauciness is of course perfectly fine as well. ;)  (No OCs, though. Sorry!)

The resulting sketches will be publicly available for everyone, patron or not, so everyone can enjoy them. Keep that in mind!

Starting next Sunday, and each subsequent Sunday, I will also begin doing Sunday Sketch Streams where I will be drawing the sketches you suggest here!

At the beginning of every month (starting December) I will hold a vote. All the sketches made in the previous month will be put up and the top picks will be made into finished full-color art, which will of course be publicly available as well.

I hope this sounds like fun for you guys! I wanted to give back to all of you who have been so generous. Up until now, you've pledged with no expectation of getting anything in return. I figured with this, those who contribute can now be rewarded. Those who can only contribute a little will still get to join in on the streams. And those that cannot contribute at all still get new sketches out of the deal! A win-win-win for everyone, I think. :)

Let me know what you think! Oh, and for this week, just to get started, anyone can feel free to make suggestions below for next week's stream, if you have any ideas!

title: Rose's Rescue
description:
An origin comic about the first meeting between Saria, Trace's future wife, and Rose, the cousin of Euchre. After being interrogated by then Grand Templar Mary Silverlock, Rose was kept a prisoner, and would have spent the rest of her life forgotten in a Templar dungeon.

Thankfully, Saria and a couple people inside the Templar arranged for her escape. Saria took Rose in, employing her as a servant (with pay!) until she could arrange travel back to wolf lands. Rose however, extremely grateful towards Saria, eventually decided she had nothing to go back to, and chose to stay.

Saria and Rose remained extremely close. Saria years later would marry Trace, ironically resulting in Rose once again ending up in Grand Templar hands after Trace took power.

This backstory comic was sketches many years ago, and finally brought to life by iliar with the creative use of a Nora Card! Thank you, iliar for helping to get this page made!

This would probably lead to Sarah feeling torn between a desire to fight the Basitins and an obligation to lead the child back home. The latter of which would likely win out, though with no small amount of grumbling and swearings of revenge directed towards Keith & co.

All and all a very different end to that particular battle, if Maeve had taken a different path toward town.

title: Magical Mishaps #1 Post-Story Discussion
description:
◄First Page ⯇Previous Page | Next Page⯈ Gallery Page► 

Dun dun duuuun...

Hello everyone! Magical Mishaps #1 is over! The next story is still in the works, so it might be a little while before we get into MM#2, especially with all the conventions coming up in July. I cannot say exactly when it will start, but I will be sure to let you know! For now, I want to give you guys an opportunity to discuss both this comic, and future upcoming comics, if you'd like, along with answering questions.

Magical Mishaps #2 will not be a sequel to MM#1. As I said before, This is an anthology of different encounters with various magical items, creatures, beasts, spells, etc. Not all Magical Mishaps stories will be full-sized like this one. I hope to do some shorter ones, in the 1 - 6 page range that cover simple, one-off mishaps.

Some stories may not involve Twokinds characters at all, but might feature new characters, monsters, and events in locations of the Twokinds world that would otherwise not be covered in the mainline series. Hopefully, you guys will still find them entertaining without most of the familiar faces!

Please, feel free to discuss what you might like to see here. I welcome hearing your thoughts. If you have comments or suggestions and would like to send them to me, you can also do so by emailing me here: stories@magicalmishaps.com (I will likely not answer most emails due to time, so don't expect it, but I will read them!)

Many tigers in the tiger lands do not have dedicated bedrooms in their homes. Instead, they usually have one large room and one large, round bed in the center, low to the ground or even built into the floor. An entire family will sleep together in this communal bed.

The bed in this art is a slightly smaller version of a traditional tiger bed. A sort of hybrid between human and tiger design, raised off the ground more than a tiger's bed would be, but still round in the traditional style.

title: Twokinds Pixel Portraits Pack
description:
Here are pixel portraits featuring most of the Twokinds canon cast of characters! (and some Riftwall faces too!) Each one was drawn on a canvas of only 25x25 pixels (except the Basitins, who are 30x25 due to their freakishly long ears).

I've created a pack you can download below with all the icons and a couple extras and variations. I have them in their native 25x25 and at 100x100 and 300x300 sizes. Please feel free to use them however you'd like. You may take them, edit them, or use them as a base to make your own - whatever you want! Enjoy!

I may in the future make an add-on pack featuring all the fan-canon characters from all the side material, and anything else I've missed. But for now, I'm exhausted. Who'd have thought making tiny little portraits would be so challenging?

Thanks to user Mark_And_1069_Others for originally inspiring me to create these.

title: Announcement - Taking a Break Next Month!
description:
Hello everyone! I wanted to let you know that I'm planning to take a temporary break from the Patreon for the month of September. This is to catch up on my backlog of work and put the focus back on the webcomic. There's nothing you need to do - luckily, Patreon has a built-in handy feature that lets me pause payments, so you won't be charged for the month while I'm gone. August colors will still happen after I return from Megaplex, but Sunday Sketch Streams will be on hold until the first week of October. After that, things will resume as normal.

The convention season, which was all bunched up into two months, on top of getting Covid for weeks has left me scrambling and behind schedule... though honestly, I was already behind schedule as it is this last year, so I think a break will do Twokinds a lot of good. I plan to build up a backlog and get back on track with my schedule, at least as best as I'm able. Any sketches I still owe will be finished during my sabbatical.

This will be the first official break I've taken from the Patreon since I first began the sketch blog. I'm a little scared to put it on hold like this, but I think it's necessary. Thank you for understanding and being along for the ride with all these sketch suggestions. I will return next month for a sketch stream on October 6th!

edit: Just to be clear, this is not a break from Twokinds, just the sketch blog! I will be focusing my efforts on putting out more comic pages.

title: Lynx Royalty
description:
Two lynx boys... and one very flustered faux-lynx in the middle.

This is not a patron pick or Nora Card, just purely something I wanted to color for myself, and finally had a chance to do so! Inks are by Narikusha, without whom I would not have the time for misc art like this! (It was actually inked aged ago, but free time is scarce! Sorry!)

I am still mulling over names for these two lynx princes. I'd like it to be something suitable for the setting, but names are hard, so I'm still deciding. Probably something soft and refined for the lanky prince, and more powerful and heavy for the big prince. They might also need to be plant-based, if I'm continuing the theme of cat keidran being named after nature. Luckily, Reed's name already naturally fits the theme! Maybe Prince Sorrel? And Prince Rowan? One's a slender plant, and the other is a tree with red berries. Let me know what you think.

And yes, these three are color coordinated RGB.

title: Digital Commission Update
description:
For those that submitted for the digital commissions, thank you! I'll be reading through all the submissions and making the selection by the 15th. Keep an eye out for my email! I may have follow up questions.

Note: Some of you need to be more careful with your ref links. Make sure they actually work for others, even without an account. Also, it's very helpful if you combine all refs into one image, instead of multiple image files or a whole directory.

title: Dress Shirt Colin
description:
Sam's playing dress-up with Colin.

The final color for August (Trace vs Keith - GenderSwap AU) is a little delayed, as the previous colors were very time-intensive to paint. So... here's a little doodle of Colin, which I used as the host for last month's color stream, as a placeholder until I can get the last one finished.

title: Access Denied
description:
For those that send me requests for the sketch commission form, maybe... uh... maybe check your ref links in an incognito window and make sure it can be accessed by someone else.

(Flora's my secretary. She can't read, so she needs the pretty pictures to judge them)

Also, those that sent me many image files... it'd be really helpful if you just had ONE ref image, like a combination of all the stuff you wanted so it's easier on me. Just saying, it'll help your odds a bit, if you want to have an edge.

title: MisSpell'd - Side Comic!
description:
You can also check out the dedicated website here: https://www.2kinds.com/misspelld/ It has comparisons to the originals and transcripts of each page.

This is a remake of a mini side comic I did in 2012.

I wanted to revisit it both as a fun experiment and to celebrate the 22nd anniversary of Twokinds, bringing some lesser-known pages from the past into my current style. Going back and digging up the old Na’Rella assets was incredibly nostalgic for me, and I hope it is for you. If you remember these pages from before, I hope you like the updated version (including 3 brand-new additional pages!) and if this is your first time seeing these at all, I hope you enjoy the experience!

Thank you for being a part of Twokinds. I'm so glad I can still make these silly adventures for you guys after all these years!


The zip below contains speechless versions of all pages.

title: Northern Basitins - New Family
description:
Somewhere far to the north, Basitin exiles make their home in the snowy regions of the world. And one family in particular discovers that they have an unexpected new member, and more on the way.

Sequel to: https://www.patreon.com/posts/northern-couple-79558508

Inked by Narikusha!

Edit:

There's a new tag called Northern Lands which encompasses all art relating to the snowy far northern regions of the world (or characters specifically from there) such as the Snow Basitins. There's some overlap with Snow Leopard Village, but that's okay.

title: Announcing - Magical Mishaps Vol 1
description:
To celebrate the holidays this year, I will begin posted the full-color version of Magical Mishaps Vol 1 "The Collar" one page per day, starting this week. Some of you may recall the sketch version from 2018. This will be the complete, full-color version, being released online for the first time!

This is in addition to the regularly scheduled sketches and the Twokinds main comic, which will be starting its next chapter this week as well.

These will be for all members, and you have my permission to repost them elsewhere if you wish. Once all the pages are out, I will make a post with all of it collected into a single zip file, and mirror it on my Deviantart as usual.

I hope you will enjoy the pretty pictures of Mrs Nibbly. Have a good holiday and a wonderful rest of the year!

Your Artist,
-Tom

I also welcome fan translations! I'm happy to include them here, if they're done well.
